title: STAT3003: Fundamentals of Statistical Algorithm
text:
This course introduces the fundamental ideas and computational tools behind modern statistical algorithms. Topics include random-variable generation, Monte Carlo methods, optimization, Markov chain Monte Carlo, and bootstrap methods.



A visual overview of random-number generation, Markov chain Monte Carlo, and bootstrap resampling.

title: About me
text:
Welcome! I am a Full Researcher (tenure-track) at Faculty of Business for Science and Technology, School of Management, University of Science and Technology of China (USTC). I received my Ph.D. degree from Florida State University (FSU) in 2022 under the supervision of Professor Xin Henry Zhang and Professor Qing Mai. I received my B.S. degree from USTC in 2017.
My research interests mainly cover dimension reduction, high-dimensional statistics, robust statistics, and tensor data analysis. I am also interested in their applications in other statistical areas, e.g., extreme value theory, transfer learning, mixture model. My research is also motivated by many real applications, including finance, neuroimaging, brain imaging, multi-omics, and genomics.


Education

2017/08–2022/05: Ph.D. in Statistics, Florida State University.

title: STAT2002: Probability Theory and Mathematical Statistics
text:
This course introduces probability theory and mathematical statistics, covering events, conditional probability, independence, random variables and joint distributions, expectation and variance, and limit theorems. Building on these foundations, it develops statistical inference through sampling distributions, point and interval estimation, large-sample theory, bootstrap methods, and hypothesis testing, including p-values, likelihood-ratio tests, and goodness-of-fit tests.



Random experiments, probability distributions, confidence intervals, and hypothesis tests.

title: Copula 模型
text:
← 返回 STAT3003
依赖结构 + 边际分布 = 联合分布先生成 (U, V) ∼ C，再令 X = F₁⁻¹(U)、Y = F₂⁻¹(V)。改变边际分布，观察同一组点如何变形。

设置模型
CopulaGaussian · 高斯Student tClayton · 下尾依赖Gumbel · 上尾依赖Independence · 独立
相关参数 ρ0.50
Copula 自由度 ν

X 的边际分布Uniform(0, 1)Normal(0, 1)Student t(df = 4)Exponential(rate = 1)Lognormal(0, 1)Beta(2, 5)Y 的边际分布Uniform(0, 1)Normal(0, 1)Student t(df = 4)Exponential(rate = 1)Lognormal(0, 1)Beta(2, 5)样本数200100030005000
随机种子
重新抽样重置
设置自动生效；只改边际时保留 (U, V)。同一设置和种子可复现实验。

课件示例均匀边际 · ρ = 0.5正态边际 · ρ = 0.9t + 正态 · ρ = 0.5
① Copula 样本U、V 的边际均为 Uniform(0, 1)② 边际变换后的样本

点的颜色按 U 从蓝到橙变化，两图中相同颜色对应相同样本。坐标轴覆盖全部样本；重尾分布可能使中部点更集中。直方图表示各区间的样本数。
如何观察？固定 Copula，只改变一个边际：秩相关保持不变，但 Pearson 相关系数可能变化。Gaussian 的 ρ 是潜在正态变量的相关系数，一般不等于变换后 X、Y 的相关系数。比较 Gaussian、Clayton 和 Gumbel：观察左下角或右上角点的聚集。Student t Copula 即使 ρ = 0 也通常不独立。Copula 自由度与 t 边际的自由度是不同的参数。
对应的 R 代码使用相同模型与参数；R 与浏览器的随机数生成器不同，具体样本不会逐点一致。
参考：R copula 包 · 基于 Slides 1.2 §6.4 的逆变换模拟。
